snapshot.text: Tax-funded public system run by the Health Service Executive (HSE) alongside a large private insurance sector. Sláintecare, the long-term reform towards universal care, frames policy; long waiting lists remain the main political problem.

priorities.title: Waiting Time Action Plan 2026
priorities.text: Published January 2026: half of patients within Sláintecare limits (10 weeks outpatient, 12 weeks inpatient) and 90% waiting under 12 months for a first outpatient appointment.

priorities.title: HSE National Service Plan 2026
priorities.text: The HSE's 2026 service plan sets out what the health service will deliver with this year's budget.

priorities.title: Capital and digital investment
priorities.text: The NDP sectoral plan for health 2026–2030 and HSE capital plans, including €263 million for digital health in 2026.
